about_the_game:
Baradroid – Lost Data: Director’s Cut is a free DLC featuring fully voiced scenes from the original demo — content cut during development and never made it into the final game; the NSFW scenes don't have any voice.

After the release of the Baradroid, many players expressed frustration with the limited scope and the absence of promised content, including Caleb’s route. While we’re no longer able to deliver that expanded storyline, this Director’s Cut offers a glimpse into what once was in the works.

There is no new gameplay. Instead, this is a small, heartfelt thank you — a way to revisit the early moments of Baradroid with new emotional depth, now fully voiced for the first time.

content_descriptors.notes: Baradroid contains revealing outfits, sexual stimulation, sexual innuendo, sex-related language, masturbation, and explicit sexual scenes. It's a game destined for adult players.
